CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

6. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

9. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

10. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   C. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Photography.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
